name: Kinetic Pop & Spring
render: const canvas = ctx.root.querySelector('#mgt-canvas'); const w = ctx.width; const h = ctx.height; if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) { canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h; } const g = canvas.getContext('2d'); g.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); const p = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ctx.progress)); if (p <= 0) { g.drawImage(ctx.inputA, 0, 0, w, h); return; } if (p >= 1) { g.drawImage(ctx.inputB, 0, 0, w, h); return; } const params = ctx.params || {}; const overshoot = params.overshoot !== undefined ? Number(params.overshoot) : 1.45; const stiffness = params.stiffness !== undefined ? Number(params.stiffness) : 13.5; const damping = params.damping !== undefined ? Number(params.damping) : 5.2; const spinRad = ((params.spinAngle !== undefined ? Number(params.spinAngle) : 14) * Math.PI) / 180; const chroma = params.chromaticEcho !== undefined ? Number(params.chromaticEcho) : 0.65; const accent = params.accentColor || '#00f0ff'; const cx = w * 0.5; const cy = h * 0.5; const split = 0.28; if (p < 0.58) { const tA = Math.min(1, p / 0.42); const backA = 1 + (overshoot * 0.8 + 1) * Math.pow(tA - 1, 3) + (overshoot * 0.8) * Math.pow(tA - 1, 2); const scaleA = Math.max(0.001, 1 - tA * 0.92 + Math.sin(tA * Math.PI) * 0.14 * overshoot); const rotA = -spinRad * Math.pow(tA, 2.2); const alphaA = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.pow( Math.max(0, (p - 0.18) / 0.36), 1.8)); if (chroma > 0 && tA > 0.05) { g.save(); g.translate(cx, cy); g.rotate(rotA * 1.15); g.scale(scaleA * (1 + 0.04 * chroma), scaleA * (1 - 0.02 * chroma)); g.globalAlpha = alphaA * 0.35 * chroma; g.drawImage(ctx.inputA, -cx, -cy, w, h); g.restore(); } g.save(); g.translate(cx, cy); g.rotate(rotA); g.scale(scaleA, scaleA); g.globalAlpha = alphaA; g.drawImage(ctx.inputA, -cx, -cy, w, h); g.restore(); } if (p >= split * 0.65) { const tB = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (p - split * 0.65) / (1 - split * 0.65))); const decay = Math.exp(-damping * tB); const endDecay = Math.exp(-damping); const wave = Math.cos(stiffness * tB); const endWave = Math.cos(stiffness); const rawSpring = 1 - decay * wave * (1 + overshoot * 0.35 * (1 - tB)); const rawEnd = 1 - endDecay * endWave; const scaleB = tB >= 0.999 ? 1 : Math.max(0.001, rawSpring / (rawEnd || 1)); const rotB = spinRad * (1 - tB) * decay * Math.sin(stiffness * tB * 0.7); const alphaB = Math.min(1, Math.pow(tB / 0.22, 1.4)); const vel = Math.abs(1 - scaleB); if (chroma > 0 && vel > 0.003) { const echoCount = 3; for (let i = echoCount; i >= 1; i--) { const factor = i / echoCount; const eScale = scaleB * (1 + (scaleB - 1) * 0.28 * factor * chroma); const eRot = rotB * (1 + 0.35 * factor * chroma); g.save(); g.translate(cx, cy); g.rotate(eRot); g.scale(Math.max(0.001, eScale), Math.max(0.001, eScale)); g.globalAlpha = alphaB * (0.22 / i) * chroma * Math.min(1, vel * 4); g.drawImage(ctx.inputB, -cx, -cy, w, h); g.restore(); } } if (tB > 0.02 && tB < 0.55 && chroma > 0) { const ringP = (tB - 0.02) / 0.53; const radius = Math.hypot(w, h) * 0.55 * Math.pow(ringP, 0.55); g.save(); g.beginPath(); g.arc(cx, cy, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.strokeStyle = accent; g.lineWidth = Math.max(2, (1 - ringP) * Math.min(w, h) * 0.035 * chroma); g.globalAlpha = (1 - ringP) * 0.55 * chroma; g.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen'; g.stroke(); g.restore(); } g.save(); g.translate(cx, cy); g.rotate(rotB); g.scale(scaleB, scaleB); g.globalAlpha = alphaB; g.drawImage(ctx.inputB, -cx, -cy, w, h); if (tB < 0.28) { const flash = (1 - tB / 0.28) * 0.45 * chroma; g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = accent; g.globalAlpha = flash; g.fillRect(-cx, -cy, w, h); } g.restore(); }
